stem: The equation d = 16t represents the distance d, in inches, an object has traveled t seconds after it started moving. Which of the following is the best interpretation of 16 in this context?

choices.A: The object moved a total of 16 inches
choices.B: The object moved a total of 16t inches
choices.C: The object is moving at a rate of 16 inches per second
choices.D: The object is moving at a rate of 1/16 inches per second

distractor_rationales.A: Student interpreted the coefficient as a total distance rather than a rate
distractor_rationales.B: Student restated the expression without interpreting the 16
distractor_rationales.D: Student inverted the rate

solution_steps: In d = 16t, the coefficient 16 is multiplied by t (seconds)
For each additional second, d increases by 16 inches
16 is the rate in inches per second
why_this_difficulty: Easy: slope-as-rate in a clean proportional model.

stem: The function f is defined by f(n) = 25n + 30, where f(n) is the total cost, in dollars, of ordering n picture frames. Which of the following is the best interpretation of 25 in this context?

distractor_rationales.D: Student confused the coefficient 25 with the variable n

solution_steps: In f(n) = 25n + 30, the coefficient 25 is multiplied by n
Each additional frame adds $25 to the total
25 is the cost per frame; 30 is the fixed order fee
why_this_difficulty: Easy: cost-per-item framing with both slope and intercept positive.

stem: A bike rider's remaining ride distance, in miles, after t minutes is given by D(t) = 12 − 0.2t. Which of the following is the best interpretation of 0.2 in this context?

0.2 is the rate of decrease in miles per minute

stem: The function f is linear. The table shows f(2) = 13 and f(6) = 29. If h(x) = f(x) − 13, what is h(10)?

distractor_rationales.45: Student found f(10) but forgot to subtract 13

why_this_difficulty: Hard: derive f from a table, then shift to h and evaluate.

stem: A plumber charges a flat fee of $75 for a service call plus $50 per hour worked. If the total charge for a job was $225, for how many hours did the plumber work?

distractor_rationales.A: Student subtracted 75 then divided by 75
distractor_rationales.C: Student added 75 before dividing
distractor_rationales.D: Student divided 225 by 50 without subtracting flat fee

why_this_difficulty: Hard: set up equation from context, identify flat vs. per-hour, solve.

stem: The cost of renting a backhoe for up to 10 days is $270 for the first day and $135 for each additional day. Which equation gives the cost y, in dollars, of renting the backhoe for x days, where x is a positive integer and x ≤ 10?

distractor_rationales.A: Student used 270 as per-day rate
distractor_rationales.B: Student misapplied structure
distractor_rationales.C: Student kept 270 as intercept

why_this_difficulty: Hard: tiered pricing where first unit differs; requires algebraic expansion.

stem: One gallon of paint covers 220 square feet of wall, and a double coat is to be applied. How many gallons are needed to double-coat a wall that is 1100 square feet?

distractor_rationales.220: Student reported coverage rate as answer

solution_steps: Total area to be covered = 1100 × 2 = 2200 sq ft
why_this_difficulty: Hard: two-step — doubled coverage times area, then divide by rate.

stem: A linear model estimates the population of a city from 1991 to 2015. The model estimates the population was 57 thousand in 1991, 224 thousand in 2011, and x thousand in 2015. To the nearest whole number, what is the value of x?
why_this_difficulty: Hard: derive rate from 2 points, then extrapolate to a 3rd.

stem: A scuba diver measures pressure below the water surface. At 0 meters the pressure is 1 atm, and at 10 meters the pressure is 2 atm. If the pressure is a linear function of depth, what is the pressure, in atm, at 33 meters?

distractor_rationales.3.3: Student used slope 1/10 without adding surface pressure

why_this_difficulty: Hard: extrapolate beyond given points.

stem: A window-repair company charges a fixed trip fee plus an hourly labor rate. A 3-hour job cost $190, and a 5-hour job cost $270. What will an 8-hour job cost, in dollars?

distractor_rationales.320: Student used slope only without trip fee
distractor_rationales.400: Student overshot by adding extra hour

why_this_difficulty: Hard: 3 data points (2 given, 1 target); fit linear model and evaluate.

stem: The equation F = (9/5)C + 32 gives the temperature F, in degrees Fahrenheit, corresponding to a temperature of C degrees Celsius. What is the value of C when F = 68?
why_this_difficulty: Hard: multi-step solve with fractional coefficient in a literal formula.

stem: The equation h = 9(v − 273.15)/5 + 32 gives the temperature h, in degrees Fahrenheit, of any substance that has a temperature of v kelvins, where v > 0. If a substance has a temperature of 467.33 degrees Fahrenheit, what is the corresponding temperature, in kelvins, of this substance?
why_this_difficulty: Hard: multi-step solve with fractions and offset in a compound formula.

stem: The function F is defined by F(x) = (9/5)(x − 273.15) + 32, giving the Fahrenheit temperature F corresponding to x kelvins. If the temperature of a substance increases by 2.10 kelvins, by how many degrees Fahrenheit does its temperature increase?
why_this_difficulty: Hard: interpret slope coefficient 9/5 as a unit-conversion ratio.

stem: The function P is defined by P(t) = 300 − 4t, where P(t) is the volume of water in a container, in liters, t minutes after draining begins. Which of the following is the best interpretation of −4 in this context?

choices.A: The container starts with −4 liters of water
choices.B: The volume of water decreases by 4 liters each minute
choices.C: The volume of water increases by 4 liters each minute

distractor_rationales.A: Student interpreted the coefficient as an amount
distractor_rationales.C: Student ignored the negative sign
distractor_rationales.D: Student confused the coefficient with an elapsed time

solution_steps: Volume decreases by 4 liters each minute
why_this_difficulty: Hard: signed-coefficient interpretation with negative slope.

stem: A scientist models the weight of a piglet using W(x) = a + bx, where a is the birth weight in kilograms and b is the growth rate in kilograms per week. If a week-4 measurement gives W(4) = 3.2 kg, and the birth weight was 1.2 kg, which of the following is the best interpretation of b in this model?

choices.A: The total weight, in kilograms, after 4 weeks
choices.B: The piglet gains 0.5 kilogram per week
choices.C: The piglet weighs 0.5 kilogram at birth
choices.D: The total weight gained over 4 weeks

distractor_rationales.A: Student named total output rather than rate
distractor_rationales.C: Student interpreted slope as intercept
distractor_rationales.D: Student named an aggregate rather than rate

solution_steps: b = 0.5 kg/week means piglet gains 0.5 kg per week
why_this_difficulty: Hard: combine parameter recovery with contextual interpretation.

stem: The function f is defined by f(x) = 6x − 11. What is the value of f(5) − f(2)?

distractor_rationales.30: Student computed 6 × 5 only without subtracting f(2)
distractor_rationales.19: Student computed f(5) − f(2) as 19 by arithmetic slip
distractor_rationales.3: Student subtracted inputs only (5 − 2) without applying f

why_this_difficulty: Medium: single-function difference — tests the insight that f(b) − f(a) = slope × (b − a) for a linear function.
sat_key_phrases: the function f is defined by

stem: The function f is defined by f(x) = 2x − 7. What is the value of f(k + 3) in terms of k?

distractor_rationales.A: Student distributed 2 across (k + 3) but subtracted 7 − 3 = 4 instead of applying −7 to the full expression
distractor_rationales.C: Student replaced x with k and added 3 to f(k) instead of substituting (k + 3)
distractor_rationales.D: Student doubled (k + 3) correctly but dropped the −7

why_this_difficulty: Medium: abstract variable substitution where the input is a symbolic expression, not a number. Tests distributive property and sign tracking.
sat_key_phrases: the function f is defined by

stem: The function f is defined by f(x) = 240 − 12x, where f(x) is the amount of water, in liters, remaining in a reservoir x hours after a leak began. In the xy-plane, the graph of y = f(x) has an x-intercept at (c, 0). Which of the following is the best interpretation of c in this context?

choices.A: The initial amount of water, in liters, in the reservoir
choices.B: The rate at which water is leaking, in liters per hour
choices.C: The time, in hours, at which the reservoir is empty
choices.D: The total amount of water, in liters, lost in 12 hours

distractor_rationales.A: Student interpreted the x-intercept as the y-intercept
distractor_rationales.B: Student named the slope (rate of change)
distractor_rationales.D: Student computed f(12) and reported that

solution_steps: x-intercept occurs when f(x) = 0, i.e., when the water runs out
c = 20, interpreted as 20 hours after the leak began the reservoir is empty
why_this_difficulty: Medium: tests recognition that the x-intercept represents the input value where output (amount of water) hits zero, giving contextual meaning (time to empty).

stem: A new-business owner models monthly profit, in dollars, with the function P(m) = 450m − 5400, where m is the number of months since opening. The graph of y = P(m) crosses the m-axis at (c, 0). What is the best interpretation of c?

choices.A: The initial startup cost, in dollars
choices.B: The number of months needed for the business to break even
choices.C: The monthly profit, in dollars, at month 450
choices.D: The total profit, in dollars, over 12 months

distractor_rationales.A: Student named the y-intercept role
distractor_rationales.C: Student confused the slope with the x-intercept
distractor_rationales.D: Student estimated a total rather than a specific time

solution_steps: At m = 12, profit = 0, so the business breaks even after 12 months
why_this_difficulty: Medium: business-context x-intercept interpretation (break-even), requires mapping zero profit to real-world meaning.

stem: The function f is defined by f(x) = 2x + 3. In the xy-plane, line j is parallel to the graph of y = f(x). What is the slope of line j?

distractor_rationales.3: Student reported the y-intercept of f as the slope
distractor_rationales.-1/2: Student computed the perpendicular slope instead of the parallel slope

solution_steps: Slope of f is the coefficient of x: 2
Parallel lines have equal slopes, so slope of j = 2
why_this_difficulty: Medium: tests the definition of parallel lines (equal slopes) when one line is given in function-notation form.
sat_key_phrases: the function f is defined by

stem:
The function f is defined by f(x) = ax + b, where a and b are constants. The table below gives some values of x and their corresponding values of f(x).

x | f(x)
1 | −64
2 | 0
3 | 64

What is the value of a − b?

distractor_rationales.64: Student found slope a = 64 but did not find b or evaluate a − b
distractor_rationales.−192: Student computed b − a = −128 − 64 instead of a − b
distractor_rationales.−64: Student used b = −64 (mistaking the f(1) value for the y-intercept) and computed 64 − (−64) = 128, or made a sign error

solution_steps: Find y-intercept b: f(x) = 64x + b; use (2, 0): 0 = 64(2) + b → b = −128
why_this_difficulty: Medium: student must derive both parameters from the table and then evaluate an algebraic expression of them, not just report slope or intercept individually.

what is the value of a − b

stem: The function f is defined by f(x) = 4x − 8. The graph of y = f(x) has an x-intercept at (a, 0) and a y-intercept at (0, c). What is the value of a + c?

distractor_rationales.2: Student found a = 2 (x-intercept) but forgot to include c = −8
distractor_rationales.−8: Student found c = −8 (y-intercept) but forgot to include a = 2
distractor_rationales.6: Student computed |a| + |c| or confused signs: 2 + 8 = 10, or took a = −2

why_this_difficulty: Medium: requires computing BOTH intercepts of the same line then evaluating a combined expression; distinct from single-intercept templates.
